cards.name: Hypatia
cards.flavor: Hypatia is a boisterous, larger-than-life member of your crew, prone to roughhousing and reckless outbursts. Wherever she goes, she brings an air of lighthearted humor with her, able to brighten any dour mood. When asked what she remembers of awakening in the Argonaut Mausoleum, she laughs, joking that she shouldn't be here at all, making up a story about being caught up in nets of the last Titanaktisos expedition

cards.name: Anakreon
cards.flavor: Distant, reserved, aloof. All of these descriptors and more have been given to Anakreon by the Argo's crew. He carries himself with an air of superiority, bordering on arrogance. With his sharp, almost feline features and shock of hair as pale as polished sireshell, some whisper that he is a descendant of the Silver Ones, oof Atlantis itself. Maybe he is one of the Silver Princes, returned just in time to face the Eschaton. Or maybe that's just a fairytale, wishful thinking in a dark time...

cards.name: Anathea of Baktria
cards.flavor: The Argo's crew were quick to assume that Anathea was of Baktria, in the shadow of the Silk Road that reaches far beyond the bounds of Hellas to the East. That would certainly explain the wanderlust in her eyes, and the fiery restlessness in her heart. Driven by a desire to grasp the horizon and find out what lies beyond the next mountiain range, she has taken to the voyaging life of the Argo with gusto. Who knows to which far-flung corner of the world the city-ship will take her?

cards.name: Orphan of D'Mt
cards.flavor: In spite of the void in their memories left by the awakening process of the Mausoleum, there is one thing that stands clear in the Orphan's mind--they have known lineliness, and loss. This overwhelming sense of emptiness drives them as keenly as any instinct, both to protect what little they have found aboard the Argo, and to struggle to get by without help. The need for familial connections is constantly at war with their independent streak. They would give their all for the Argo, even if that meant losing their own place on the ship

cards.name: Aster
cards.flavor: Every time Aster closes her eyes, she can see it. A city of gold and glass, stretching ever upwards. Everything you could wish for, within reach of your fingertips. If you could afford it. For those born into the shadows below, there is no such paradise. Just toil and privation. Deep within, she's known this life of struggle, understands it. And yet now, she's an Argonaut, living atop the mighty city-ship. To some, it would seem like she's made it, climbed out of that old, black pit. Hasn't she?

cards.name: Dastan
cards.flavor: Since the first moment he awoke in the Mausoleum, Dastan has felt a compulsion to look upward, to dream skyward. His sleeping thouts swell with visions of reaching to the heavens, and beyond. In a world where mortals war over resources and land, perhaps out there, in the great reaches past the clouds, there might be enough for everyone...

cards.name: Aktisaeos
cards.flavor: While he may not recall much from his time before the Mausoleum, there is one thing Aktisaeos is certain of -- he was once destined for greatness. He can feel it in his very bones, in the depths of his gut. This leads him to tend to step forward into leadership, often addressing the crew of the Argo and the disparate peoples the city-ship encounters with an authoritative, commanding tone

cards.name: Oleander
cards.flavor: A road vanishing into the East, a Kingdom under the sky, mountains like the spine of some megalithic corpse. These images and more fill Oleander's dreams, fadingeach morning as they awaken to the life of an Argonaut. Fight, struggle, survive. Is that all there is for them? No, there must be more. That open horizon and total liberation they see in their mind's eye... They'll have that, someday. Once the Argo's mission is over. Once they've helped bring peace to the world

cards.name: Ómorfos
cards.flavor: Since their awakening in the Mausoleum, Ómorfos has been underestimated by those around them. People see the chiseled jawline, the broad shoulders, and the heavyset build, and assume them to be some kind of bull-headed brute. Not so, for this Argonaut carries all the shrewdness and cunning of an Atlantean, and if you've underestimated them, you've already slipped into their trap
